lead_headline: Olive & Finch preps fifth Denver location as restaurant pipeline swells to 118 active leads

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today holds the active pipeline at 118 (61 openings, 57 closures). Recent adds: Olive & Finch (Golden Triangle), Maryjane's Hideaway (Sloan Lake), Lost Coffee (Arvada).

liquor.blurb: 6 new applications today breaks Monday-Tuesday's drought with restaurant-heavy filings: The Pit Shop (Wadsworth BBQ/fermented malt), El Pulgarcito de Bukele (Federal Blvd Salvadoran), Culture (Welton St tavern/cabaret), El Tigre de Santa Julia (17th St hotel/restaurant), Moonlight Liquors (Tower Rd store), and The Runway and Rye Lounge (DIA airport hotel/restaurant). The Wednesday bounce returns to seasonal patterns after two zero-application days. Status changes spike to 34 as State clears delinquency backlog — John Holly's Bistro, Rio Grande Liquor, and Bamboo Sushi all return to active status from delinquent classification.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions yesterday (Instagram 1, Facebook 1) lifts the 7-day total to 30 across 8 sources — down 46% from last week's 56-mention baseline and marking the fourth consecutive weekly decline. Instagram (10) maintains weekly dominance ahead of Facebook (5), Denver Post (4), and Hoodline (3). The sustained four-week contraction suggests development news cycle exhaustion as major announcements thin heading into May. Notable pickups: Projects+ platform launch (Instagram), Govnr's Park Tavern 1976 history feature (Facebook), and downtown office conversion loan denial (Denver Post). The extended slowdown signals structural shift as spring construction news plateaus.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) holds MTD at +18 (+0.8/day), 90-day net at +141. The past week delivered just +2 net (6 new, 4 canceled) — an 85% collapse from last week's +13 performance as acquisition dried up completely. The last five consecutive days produced zero net change, marking the longest flatline since February. Yet MTD's +18 performance through 23 days suggests conversion front-loaded early April — the first 11 days generated +16 net before late-month momentum stalled. YTD's +1.3/day pace continues outpacing MTD's +0.8/day, reflecting stronger Q1 fundamentals. Churn remains healthy (just 4 cancellations across 7 days), but acquisition has gone dormant as we approach month-end.
